title: Enterprise Connectivity: resource-count ceiling
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following resource-count ceiling for each named contract tier. Maximum provisioned resource count in one holding; integer.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | resource-count ceiling | 64 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | resource-count ceiling | 64 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | resource-count ceiling | 64 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | resource-count ceiling | 64 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | resource-count ceiling | 64 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | resource-count ceiling | 64 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the resource-count ceiling is 64.
